description: This file contains unit tests for the PyTorch functorch control flow functionalities, including control flow operators like cond, while_loop, map, and scan, as well as gradient and autograd support, handling of tensors, module integration, and GPU compatibility.

classes.name: TestControlFlow
classes.description: This class contains a comprehensive suite of unit tests for PyTorch's functorch control flow operators, including cond, while_loop, map, and scan, covering autograd, GPU support, nested control flow, module integration, and error handling.

classes.name: AssociativeScanModels

classes.name: AssociativeScanTests
classes.description: Test suite for verifying behavior, autograd correctness, graph generation, and error handling of associative_scan in various configurations, including edge cases and complex nested structures.
